name: dual specificity phosphatase 22
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: DUSP22 encodes dual specificity protein phosphatase 22. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
